labeler_note: App fully unusable (crash loop) for a paying customer - high, not urgent, since there's a workaround-free but single-user impact.
Double charge + explicit refund ask from a paying customer. Money-out-of-pocket issues get high priority.
Simple how-to question, free tier, no urgency stated.
Nice-to-have UI request, no business impact mentioned.
Account lockout + explicit deadline tomorrow + enterprise tier. Time-boxed real-world impact pushes this to urgent.
Post-cancellation charge, customer explicitly upset and wants immediate refund.
Irreversible data loss, enterprise tier, customer says 'extremely urgent'. Clear urgent case.
Security/account-compromise concern, not a product bug per se - judgment call, but urgency is clear regardless of bucket.
Blocking SSO error for an enterprise rollout. Serious and tied to enterprise deal, but single integration issue (not full outage) so high rather than urgent.
